entries.title: Psalms 19:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the expanse proclaims His handiwork.

entries.title: Psalms 19:2
segments: Day by day [they] pour forth speech, and night to night reveals knowledge.

entries.title: Psalms 19:3
segments: [There is] no speech nor [are] there words [where] their voice is not heard.

entries.title: Psalms 19:4
segments: Their line has gone out through all the earth and their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,

entries.title: Psalms 19:5
segments: and he comes forth as a bridegroom from his canopy; he rejoices as a strong man to run a race,

entries.title: Psalms 19:6
segments: going forth from the end of the heavens, and its course [is] to their ends. And there is nothing hid from its heat.

entries.title: Psalms 19:7
segments: The law of the LORD [is] perfect, converting the soul; the testimony of the LORD [is] sure, making the simple wise.

entries.title: Psalms 19:8
segments: The statutes of the LORD [are] right, rejoicing the heart; the commandments of the LORD [are] pure, giving light to the eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 19:9
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] clean, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD [are] true [and] righteous altogether,

entries.title: Psalms 19:10
segments: more to be desired than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

entries.title: Psalms 19:11
segments: And Your servant is warned by them; in keeping them there [is] great reward.

entries.title: Psalms 19:12
segments: Who can understand [his] errors? Oh make me pure from secret [faults];

entries.title: Psalms 19:13
segments: and keep Your servant back from presumptuous [sins]; do not let them rule over me; then I shall be upright, and I shall be innocent of great transgression.

entries.title: Psalms 19:14
segments: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
